```yaml
name: Integration Tests - Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 2 AM UTC
    - cron: "0 2 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  extract-and-run:
    name: Extract and Run Commands
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Generated 253 deduplicated configs from matrix-generator.ts
          # These represent various combinations of:
          # - package manager (yarn/npm)
          # - build type (dev/prod)
          # - platform (ios/android)
          # - manual trigger (true/false)
          # - apk/aab (true/false)
          # - pull request (true/false)
          # - branch (main/master)
          # - cache settings
          # - other flags
          # Each entry includes:
          # - packageManager: 'yarn' | 'npm'
          # - buildType: 'dev' | 'prod'
          # - platform: 'ios' | 'android'
          # - manual: boolean
          # - apk: boolean
          # - aab: boolean
          # - pullRequest: boolean
          # - branch: 'main' | 'master'
          # - cache: string (e.g., 'yarn', 'npm')
          # - extraFlags: string (optional)
          # - fixtureDir: 'yarn-app' | 'npm-app'
          # - workflowPath: path to generated workflow YAML
          # - workflowName: name of workflow file
          # - jobName: name of job in workflow
          # - stepName: name of step in job
          # - runCommand: the actual command to run
          # - expectedExitCode: 0 or 1
          # - description: human-readable description
          # Example entries:
          - packageManager: yarn
            buildType: dev
            platform: ios
            manual: false
            apk: false
            aab: false
            pullRequest: false
            branch: main
            cache: yarn
            extraFlags: ""
            fixtureDir: yarn-app
            workflowPath: examples/generalized-workflow.yml
            workflowName: generalized-workflow.yml
            jobName: build-ios
            stepName: build-ios-step
            runCommand: yarn build:ios
            expectedExitCode: 0
            description: "Yarn dev iOS build"
          - packageManager: npm
            buildType: prod
            platform: android
            manual: true
            apk: true
            aab: false
            pullRequest: true
            branch: master
            cache: npm
            extraFlags: "--verbose"
            fixtureDir: npm-app
            workflowPath: examples/custom-workflow.yml
            workflowName: custom-workflow.yml
            jobName: build-android
            stepName: build-android-step
            runCommand: npm run build:android
            expectedExitCode: 0
            description: "NPM prod Android build with verbose"
          # Additional 251 entries would be here...
          # This is a simplified example showing structure
          # In practice, this matrix would contain 253 unique configurations
          # derived from matrix-generator.ts logic
    steps:
      - name: 🏗 Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🏗 Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "yarn"
          cache-dependency-path: webapp/yarn.lock

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd webapp
          yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: 🧪 Run integration test
        id: run-integration
        run: |
          cd integration-tests
          node dist/run-single.js \
            --package-manager "${{ matrix.packageManager }}" \
            --build-type "${{ matrix.buildType }}" \
            --platform "${{ matrix.platform }}" \
            --manual ${{ matrix.manual }} \
            --apk ${{ matrix.apk }} \
            --aab ${{ matrix.aab }} \
            --pull-request ${{ matrix.pullRequest }} \
            --branch "${{ matrix.branch }}" \
            --cache "${{ matrix.cache }}" \
            --extra-flags "${{ matrix.extraFlags }}" \
            --fixture-dir "${{ matrix.fixtureDir }}" \
            --workflow-path "${{ matrix.workflowPath }}" \
            --workflow-name "${{ matrix.workflowName }}" \
            --job-name "${{ matrix.jobName }}" \
            --step-name "${{ matrix.stepName }}" \
            --run-command "${{ matrix.runCommand }}" \
            --expected-exit-code ${{ matrix.expectedExitCode }} \
            --description "${{ matrix.description }}"

      - name: 📊 Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-test-results-${{ matrix.description }}
          path: integration-tests/test-results/
          retention-days: 7

  community-repos:
    name: Test Community Repos
    needs: extract-and-run
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        repo:
          - "expo-community/example-app"
          - "expo-community/another-example"
          # Add more community repos as needed
    steps:
      - name: 🏗 Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🏗 Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "yarn"
          cache-dependency-path: webapp/yarn.lock

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd webapp
          yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: 🧪 Run community repo test
        id: run-community-test
        run: |
          cd integration-tests
          node dist/community-runner.js \
            --repo "${{ matrix.repo }}" \
            --timeout 300000

      - name: 📊 Upload community test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: community-test-results-${{ matrix.repo }}
          path: integration-tests/community-results/
          retention-days: 7

  summary:
    name: Summary Report
    needs: [extract-and-run, community-repos]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: 🏗 Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 📊 Generate summary report
        run: |
          cd integration-tests
          node dist/summary-reporter.js

      - name: 📝 Upload summary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: integration-summary-report
          path: integration-tests/summary-report.txt
          retention-days: 7

      - name: 🚨 Notify Slack on failure
        if: failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule'
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: failure
          message: "Nightly integration tests failed. Check the summary report."
```
